summary: Beamr Imaging Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer report, the non-US equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) attaching a press release dated September 22, 2026, titled 'Beamr and Intempora to Bring Real-Time ML-Safe Lossless Compression to RTMaps.' The disclosure is a routine commercial technology partnership and product demonstration with Intempora, a dSPACE company, covering lossless 12-bit Bayer and content-adaptive compression for RTMaps, showcased at AutoSens Europe in Barcelona and the dSPACE User Conference. No transaction, securities, or special-situation terms are stated; no deal terms, advisors, board recommendation, or risk-arb angle apply.
